definitions.full: H3466. Yeshanah יְשָׁנָה proper name, of a location town on southern border of Northern Israel, near Bethel , 2Chr 13:19 ; so read also 1Sam 7:12 for הַשֵּׁן ᵑ0 We Dr Klo Kit Bu; modern `Ain Siniya , 5 miles north of Beitun, ClGann J As Avr.-Juin, 1870, 490-501 Soc ZPV i, 1878, 41 Buhl Geogr. § 95, p. 173 .

occurrences.englishText: Abijah pursued Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with its villages, Jeshanah with its villages, and Ephron with its villages.
and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, and the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate: and they stood still in the gate of the guard.
